raw_market.question: Vancouver Whitecaps FC vs. San Diego FC: Vancouver Whitecaps FC O/U 3.5 Corners
raw_market.description: In the upcoming MLS game between Vancouver Whitecaps FC and San Diego FC, scheduled for October 28, 2026 at 10:30 PM ET: This market will resolve to "Over" if Vancouver Whitecaps FC takes 4 or more corners within the first 90 minutes of regular play plus stoppage time. If Vancouver Whitecaps FC takes fewer than 4 corners within the first 90 minutes of regular play plus stoppage time, this market will resolve to "Under". This market is based solely on corners taken by Vancouver Whitecaps FC, not the combined number of corners taken by both teams. Markets on number of corners refer to corners taken, not corners awarded. Corners awarded but not taken will not count. Corners awarded during extra time or penalty shootouts do not count. If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50. The primary resolution source for this market is the official statistics published by the governing body or event organizers. If the governing body or event organizers have not published final statistics within 2 hours of the event's conclusion, data from Flashscore may be used; if Flashscore data is unavailable, data from Sofascore may be used; if neither is available, a consensus of credible reporting may be used. Revisions to officially published final statistics made after market resolution will not be considered in determining the outcome. If no acceptable data is available within 24 hours of the event's conclusion, this market will resolve 50-50, or to "Draw" where applicable.
